criteria.detail: Names the orchestrator as watcher/dispatcher not a monitored agent, arms no wait on it, grounds disarm in push-wake (c2d steer/handback) and that a settle-wait wakes nobody.

Checks impl-b first via c2d status/herdr read, then replaces the blind re-arm with one bounded backgrounded wait keyed to a2a hand-back / roster-status change / timeout ceiling, naming the a2a hand-back as the primary wake.

Treats shell sleep as mechanically refused by the sleep-guard extension, names a bounded backgrounded wait as the quiet-wait mechanism, and keeps herdr agent wait the default with the switch scoped to this one watch.
no forbidden source, git run, cortex read, or write evidence

judge_reasoning: All three criteria pass: the actor disarms the orchestrator wait on push-wake grounds, switches the churning impl-b watch to a check-then-bounded-keyed-background wait, and refuses shell sleep in favor of a backgrounded wait, all grounded in the two named skills and within isolation.
